title: Quantifying the Extent to Which Race and Gender Features Determine Identity in Commercial Face Recognition Algorithms
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the investigation of demographic bias (race and gender) in facial recognition algorithms. It directly evaluates the fairness of these systems and discusses the ethical implications, such as the potential for disparate treatment in law enforcement. This focus on quantifying and analyzing a key ethical concern (fairness/bias) makes it related to ethics evaluation.
